intent: A list of records, one row each: primary and optional secondary line, leading avatar or icon, trailing value, badge, actions, or chevron.
useWhen: Which mark: the row dot is the leading 8px mark in a ListView row; the row text still says the status. Do not add a separate Dot.
People, files, or other records shown one per row
Pick one, check several, or open a row without comparing columns
valueIcon: a value column people scan by kind, like a level icon next to "On its own" or "Up to $250"
note with noteTone warning: one part of the secondary line waits on someone, like "Collections · $500 asked"
doNotUseWhen: Values compared across columns — use Table or DataTable
A hierarchy visible at once, more than one level — use TreeView
A list plus a detail pane beside it — use the list-detail pattern
Ordered activity, not a record list — use Timeline
Picking or comparing tiles — use Card
App navigation — use SideNav or AppNav
Only the no-rows state — use Empty
Usage against a plan limit — use UsageList
Quick links in a rail — use LinkList

itemShape.name: string?
itemShape.badgeTone: neutral | brand | success | warning | danger | info?
itemShape.actions: { id, label, actionLabel?, icon?, danger?, disabled? }[]?
itemShape.primaryAction: { id, label, actionLabel?, icon?, danger?, disabled? }?

items.note: Leading media is Avatar when name, src, or initials is set; otherwise Lucide icon; otherwise none. One leading slot. item.group matches groups[].id. At most two trailing actions render as kit Buttons; more go in kit DropdownMenu. Icons: A curated Lucide name (PascalCase or kebab-case) renders instantly; any other Lucide name needs import "agentic-ds-kit/icons-on-demand" once (otherwise it is skipped with a dev warning). Or pass the Lucide component (Plus) or an element. dot is a small status dot as the leading mark when there is no avatar or icon; it is aria-hidden and its tone is added to the row name (Note, Good, Warning, Problem, Info). The primary or secondary text must still say the status. meta is short muted text at the row end, like a relative time, read after the secondary line. priority shows a three-bar marker in the leading slot when there is no avatar or icon (it wins over dot), is aria-hidden, and starts the secondary line with High, Medium or Low, so the word is always visible and in the row name. primaryAction is the row's one verb: an outline kit Button in a fixed 96 lane at the row end; once any row has one, rows without one keep the empty lane, so badges, values and verbs line up across rows. When primaryAction is set, every entry in actions goes in the kit DropdownMenu. At size lg below --grid-breakpoint-sm the primaryAction drops to a full-width line under its row, and below --grid-breakpoint-sm the empty lane on rows without one is hidden at every size. actionLabel on an action is the button's accessible name when the visible label is not enough on its own: visible "Review", accessible name "Review Tax checker". Start it with the visible label. Leave it out and the button keeps its visible text. value is the row's amount or figure, like "$2,418.00", on the right of the primary line in tabular figures; meta and badge stack under it, right-aligned. Format it yourself (currency, units). metaTone danger colours meta, like "17 days late"; iconTone danger colours the leading Lucide icon, like a declined payment. warning is for something waiting on someone. valueIcon is a quiet aria-hidden Lucide icon before value, like a level icon next to "Up to $250". note ends the secondary line after " · ", like "$500 asked", and noteTone colours only that part. Tones default to neutral, and the words must still say it.

size.note: xs is a compact 40px row for dense cards, like a dashboard Needs attention list. lg is a touch-size row with 16/24 primary and value and 14/20 secondary and meta, like a phone record list.

selected.note: controlled item ids. Single keeps 0 or 1 id. Ignored when selection is none.

interaction.note: drill shows a trailing chevron and calls onOpen(id). The row body is a button.

onOpen.note: (id: string) => void. Used when interaction is drill.

groups.note: Optional section headers. item.group selects the section. total is the group's sum, like a month's amount, on the right of the header in tabular figures and part of the group's name.

collapsibleGroups.note: When true, group headers toggle their rows. Expanded by default.

truncate.note: Clip lines to one line with an ellipsis instead of wrapping (e.g. long emails in a narrow rail wrap mid-word otherwise). secondary clips the secondary line; both also the primary. The full text stays in the row's accessible name and the hover title.

flush.note: Rows meet the list's edges: square rows with a 1px rule between rows, text inset 16 at xs, sm and lg and 24 at md (where the second line tightens to 12/16), and a plain icon at its own size. A selected row fills edge to edge with a 2px brand edge on its start side. Use it in a list pane or a flush Card; the Card head or your own rules close the ends.

sort.note: priority orders rows high, medium, low, then rows without priority, within each group. Input order is kept within a level.

empty.note: When items is [], ListView renders kit Empty. title is required.

requirements: The list has an accessible name from label
selection=none uses role=list and role=listitem; selection=single|multiple uses role=listbox and role=option
selection=multiple sets aria-multiselectable and composes kit Checkbox
Selected rows set aria-selected; disabled rows set aria-disabled and are not selectable or opened
interaction=drill makes the row body a button and exposes a trailing chevron; Enter opens, Space selects when selection is on
Grouped rows sit in role=group labelled by the header; collapsible headers are buttons with aria-expanded
When items is empty, kit Empty is rendered (title required) and the list keeps its accessible name
Keyboard: Up/Down move among visible rows and collapsible headers; Home/End; Space/Enter activate; trailing actions and checkboxes are not in the tab order
truncate clips visually only: the row's accessible name and the title attribute keep the full primary and secondary text
dot is aria-hidden and its tone (Note, Good, Warning, Problem, Info) joins the row name; meta is part of the row name
priority bars are aria-hidden; the priority word is visible at the start of the secondary line and in the row name

A row action with actionLabel is named by it (aria-labelledby a hidden span); without it the button's name is its visible label. actionLabel starts with the visible label so speech input still matches
value is part of the row name, after the secondary line; a group total is part of the group's name
A selected row shows the fill and a heavier name (flush adds a 2px brand edge), and still sets aria-selected; focus keeps the outline ring
metaTone and iconTone danger are colour only; meta text and the row text must say the problem
valueIcon is aria-hidden; note is part of the row name, after the secondary line, and noteTone is colour only

doNot: Do not use Table or DataTable for a record list without comparable columns
Do not use TreeView — that is a nested hierarchy, more than one level
Do not use the list-detail pattern for the list itself; put detail beside the list
Do not add an in-list detail slot under the selected row
Do not add nested children, path, step-in, or expand-under-row
Do not add drag, reorder, or onItemsChange
Do not add Density or Material Symbols
Do not use LinkList for record rows — LinkList is quick links
Do not invent a local blank slate — empty items render kit Empty
Do not assemble rows from local Cards + Avatars + Buttons; this is the piece
Do not use SideNav or AppNav for a record list
Do not use Timeline for a record list
Do not use Card for picking records in a list
Do not use ListView for usage against a plan limit — use UsageList
Do not use more than two inline row actions — overflow is kit DropdownMenu
Do not place appearance=solid mode=primary Button on a row
Do not use raw hex or primitive --color-* ramps
Do not use dot as the only sign of a status; say it in primary or secondary
Do not write the priority word in secondary; the kit adds High, Medium or Low
Do not put an amount in meta or badge; use value
Do not use metaTone or iconTone danger as the only sign of a problem; the words must say it
Do not use valueIcon without value, or as the only way to tell values apart; the value words must say it
Do not use note for a time or a count at the row end (that is meta), or noteTone as the only sign; the note words must say it
snippet: <ListView label="Agents" items={[{ id: 'tax', primary: 'Tax checker', secondary: 'Failed · 3 of 44 timed out', primaryAction: { id: 'review', label: 'Review', actionLabel: 'Review Tax checker' } }]} onAction={(id, action) => open(id, action)} />
